# Your Daily Briefing — Tuesday 13 October

Yesterday was a quieter day with no structured training and 6,929 steps — a decent enough baseline movement day. You burned 2,400 kcal against your 2,300 target, so energy balance was essentially spot on. Nice work keeping that consistent.

Recovery is the conversation today though. Your HRV sits at 71ms against your 100-121ms baseline — that's a meaningful dip, and combined with only 6.2 hours of sleep, your body is clearly telling you it needs more restoration than stress. The good news is your resting HR at 56bpm looks solid, so keep today's session easy — a gentle run or walk, nothing that spikes intensity.

Sleep is your biggest lever right now. You're 149 days out from Chester — there's no urgency to push hard today. Aim for 8 hours tonight and watch that HRV climb back. Prioritise that over everything else.
